intent.description: UI design skill with an offline catalog of 202 design languages (84 brands, 67 styles, 50 material themes, 1 business scene). Picks one for the project automatically when none is set, writes it as DESIGN.md, implements or restyles production UI from it, and checks the result against anti-AI-slop gates. Use when the user asks to build or restyle a page or component, list or compare design styles or themes, design in the style of a known product (Linear, Vercel, Stripe, Apple), use a look such as minimal, editorial, riso, newsprint, terminal, glassmorphism, 轻盈毛玻璃, or brutalism, build a BI / 经营分析 / 数据看板 workbench, create or follow DESIGN.md, audit a page for AI slop, or restyle an existing page while keeping its look / 自动选主题、生成 DESIGN.md、按 DESIGN.md 实施 UI、页面去 AI 模板味、审查 AI 味、改稿保留原风格. Not for copy or prose de-AI rewriting (use write), HTML reports, plans, or slides (use html-artifact), screenshot or mockup recreation (use image-to-ui-skill), 3D scene or SVG asset work, code animation or video, or backend work.
